items.title: Return signed Nutzungsvertrag
items.quote: Bitte senden Sie uns ein unterschriebenes Exemplar innerhalb von 14 Werktagen ab dem Datum dieses Briefes zurück; mitgezählt werden Montag bis Samstag, nicht aber Sonntage und Feiertage.
items.computation: Letter dated Friday 04.07.2025. Period is 14 Werktage (Mon–Sat, excluding Sundays and holidays) starting from the letter's date. Under §187 Abs.1 BGB the day of the event (04.07.2025) itself is not counted, so counting starts 05.07.2025 (Saturday, which counts as a Werktag). Counting 14 Werktage forward, skipping the three intervening Sundays (06.07, 13.07, 20.07) and no NW public holidays fall in this window, lands on Monday 21.07.2025. That day is itself a Werktag, so no further shift is needed.

warnings: This is a company letter (housing cooperative), not a government authority, so the statutory 'deemed delivery' rules for authority post do not apply; the 14-Werktage period runs from the printed letter date as the letter itself states.

The letter warns that if the signed contract does not arrive in time, the flat will be re-allocated to the next member on the waiting list — worth confirming postal transit time so the signed copy actually arrives (not just is sent) by the deadline, since the clause requires it to 'eingehen' (arrive).
